Use case: stylized-concept. NEW ORIGINAL KFB SLOP CHARACTER FAMILY, not an edit or continuation of any generated sheet. Produce ONE landscape 1536x1024 true transparent PNG sheet, EXACTLY SIX complete standalone characters, THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Input image1 is ORIGINAL ink-family morphology/material reference; image2 is ORIGINAL occupational accessory craft reference. They are STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets: invent the new subjects below. Never copy their repetitive angry expressions or all-red eyeballs.

Every character is ONE WHOLE CONTINUOUS FOOTLESS dark charcoal/deep violet INK BLOB/SPLAT, thick softly rounded asymmetrical goo lobes, modeled lips and lids, irregular ivory teeth, a few detached droplets. UPRIGHT to camera, full dominant goo body visible below partial collar/accessories. No human torso, legs, feet, severed bust, lying body, cloth-shaped body or furry spikes. WHITE/IVORY SCLERA surrounding distinct RED IRIS and BLACK PUPIL in EVERY visible eye. Soft handmade plasticine volumes, fingerprints, subtle violet sheen, warm upper-left studio light, exquisite rounded clay metal/wood/glass/fabric props. Offbeat grotesque cartoon charm, not cute Pixar mascot faces, angular/gritty clay or flat purple patches.

Six expressive peak moments. Different silhouette, mouth tension, lids, gaze and body attitude BEFORE outfit; never six hat-swaps or repeated V-brow grins. Exactly TWO female-read characters in specified cells, conveyed through styling and acting within the same ink species. All mature adults. Satire of petty certainty, institutional rituals and interrupted dignity, affectionate and absurd. Just ONE or TWO bold beautifully made props per actor, held at own body with immediate physical comedy; no complex conceptual contraptions. No floating emotion symbols. NO circular O-mouths or protruding tongues; vary crooked closed smile, flat sag, clenched grin, uneven open laugh and underbite instead.

Strict separated cells with generous empty transparent gutters and safe margins around entire silhouette, props and droplets, each fits comfortably within its own cell. Comparable visual scale without identical proportions. No overlap/touching, no shared objects, no reaching to neighbors. TRUE transparent alpha in all empty spaces and holes; NO background/gradient, scenelet, scenery, floor, shadow disc, painted checkerboard, text/numbers/labels/logos/captions/borders. Occupational/historical/retro-future context through props only.

FRESH SUBJECT FAMILY: HEALTH_CARE_12_2026-11-04; sheet care-clinical.
TOP LEFT slot1 FEMALE-READ chief physician: tall broad-bottom pear ink blob, swept violet goo quiff, tiny cream medical collar and small copper earstud. Frozen grand self-assurance, one raised lid and one almost closed, CLOSED crooked two-fang smirk, eyes sideways. Presses the comically HUGE round brass diaphragm of a thick burgundy stethoscope to her OWN goo body, listening intently. One simple beautiful prop, not human anatomy, no red cross.
TOP MIDDLE slot2 male exhausted NIGHT NURSE: very low broad soft ink splat, two small drooping crown lobes, tiny teal scrub collar. Deep flat sagging lower lip, single broad bottom tooth, heavy white-eyed lids looking down, utterly spent but tender. Both goo hands cradle one plump faded coral rubber hot-water bottle wrapped in a single ivory folded towel like precious treasure. Whole ink base visible.
TOP RIGHT slot3 male proud DENTAL TECHNICIAN: compact almost spherical ink blob, cream small cap tilted, one brass monocle above eye. Eccentric enormous sideways CLENCHED irregular tooth smile, one eye squeezed and other wide. One hand delicately holds one absurdly enormous sculpted ivory molar MODEL, other holds a tiny round brass dental mirror reflecting nothing readable. No patient or surgery.
BOTTOM LEFT slot4 male baffled DIAGNOSTIC EXAMINER: tall thin crooked bean splat, soft indigo cap and tiny worn ivory shoulder collar. Huge unequal white/red/black eyes looking inward, long offended crooked UNDERBITE with three widely spaced teeth. Holds enormous thick brass magnifying glass in front of one eye, which is visibly enlarged; opposite palm displays a TINY harmless ivory bone teaching model. Just two simple rounded props.
BOTTOM MIDDLE slot5 FEMALE-READ TRIAGE ADMINISTRATOR: squat broad springy splat with coral curled goo bun and tiny teal collar. Strained wide CLENCHED grin, one white eye wide upward and one skeptical squint, lip pushed sideways. Holds a fat cream roll of blank tickets at belly and presses one big red rubber stamp into the roll end with frustrated certainty. Ticket remains short and inside her cell; no text/cross.
BOTTOM RIGHT slot6 male old PHARMACIST: medium tall drooping asymmetric triangular-rounded ink splat, soft moss cap, tiny burgundy collar and brass pince-nez. Completely FLAT tight mouth with two little teeth peeking, heavy half-lids downward. Two broad goo hands tenderly grind a single rounded wooden mortar and thick short ivory pestle against own belly, patient concentration. Beautiful worn clay wood, no bottles/recipe/medicine labels.
